description: EPA Dynamically Downscaled Ensemble (EDDE) Version 2 is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS, a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "infrastructure", published or maintained by U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (. The data are a subset of the EPA Dynamically Downscaled Ensemble (EDDE), Version 2. EDDE is a collection of physics-based modeled data that represent 3D atmospheric conditions for historical and future periods under different scenarios. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tag infrastructure and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: Quarterly. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as given on the registry page). Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws.
